Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 3.0), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.2), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
